scope: Define how approved A1 semantic slots may receive new governed HNK lexical forms. This strategy itself generates no forms and assigns no G-IDs.

default_lexeme_lane.name: NATIVE_PRIMITIVE_CANDIDATE
default_lexeme_lane.rule: A new A1 lexical concept defaults to an independently authored primitive CANDIDATE unless an already governed morphology explicitly licenses a derivation.

special_lanes.name: GOVERNED_DERIVATION
special_lanes.rule: Allowed only when a separately approved morphology rule explicitly licenses the exact derivational behavior. Resemblance to -VAN, final -I, PAR-, VAM-/VAMA-, SAR- or PARAZAMO/PARAZAMI does not by itself license derivation.

special_lanes.name: LOAN_OR_BRIDGE
special_lanes.rule: International/proper forms may be proposed only with explicit loan/bridge provenance and adaptation review. A bridge is not automatically core-count eligible; a governed lexical loan may be separately evaluated.

special_lanes.name: GRAMMAR_SENSITIVE_FUNCTIONAL
special_lanes.rule: Slots whose meaning implies syntactic productivity may receive no productive grammar from lexical authorship. If lexical semantics cannot be separated safely from grammar, the slot remains pending a grammar gate.

special_lanes.name: HOLD_SEED_RESERVED
special_lanes.rule: Slots linked to ON, KUON, MAMA, PAPA, TA, VAME or VAMATAYA cannot receive a competing new form until the linked seed is resolved or explicitly superseded in a separate lexical-authority gate.

romanization_contract.rule: A candidate using any G-ID without governed human-facing romanization remains represented canonically by G-ID sequence plus IPA. Do not invent Latin letters, digraphs or diacritics merely to make the candidate displayable.

candidate_generation_contract.pool_generation: Generate structural candidate pools independently of PT/EN/reference-language word shapes, using only governed phonological constraints and availability.
candidate_generation_contract.semantic_pairing: Pair a candidate to a semantic slot only after collision, morphology and confusion review; pairing creates authored provenance, not historical recovery.

batching_contract.reason: Use HNK40 only as a project batching quantity. It does not select forms or meanings.
batching_contract.slot_order: Follow the approved A1 semantic-slot blueprint deterministically; domain boundaries may spill across waves without semantic reassignment.
batching_contract.internal_review_blocks: Up to four groups of 10 items inside a 40-item wave for readability/QA; the wave remains one explicit human authoring gate unless a risk requires splitting.
